━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 
Task Force is a tactical & realistic military simulator set in the SCP Universe. Being assigned on terrifying and life-threatening operations, do you have what it takes to serve the Foundation? Work with up to 11 other operatives, or go in solo. Your operation, your story. 

Who can you trust? Are your employers really the allies here? 

This experience was made by Roman Entertainment

Based on the SCP Universe
